name: - BBOX
fix_description: In _transfer, accumulated pairAmount is burned from the pair and sync() is called on every non-buy transfer. Attacker can inflate pairAmount via large buys (3% accumulates), then trigger the burn via a normal transfer to manipulate pair price. Fix by removing the direct pair balance manipulation or adding a cap/cooldown on the burn mechanism.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, straightforward flash-loan-assisted token exploit with only a few steps: borrow WBNB, swap into the vulnerable token via a helper contract to bypass a transfer/sell restriction, swap back, and repay. The PoC is small and does not require deep protocol-specific reasoning beyond spotting a simple transfer-limit bypass pattern.
